qualified_claims: The actual pinned iMOD Coupler Driver.execute owns the outer initialize/update/finalize product loop.
RibaMod.update advances and finalizes the MODFLOW timestep before advancing Ribasim.
RibaMod advances Ribasim with update_until(MF6 current time * 86400), so MODFLOW timestep endpoints are Ribasim BMI advance targets.
The pinned RibaMod product driver contains no explicit UserDemand allocation-application seam.
The pinned RibaMod product driver does not override Ribasim allocation.dt or solver.saveat.
Ribasim update_until behavior is delegated through the generic XMI wrapper rather than redefined by RibaMod.
interpretation: The actual product driver owns outer time coordination but delegates the internal management-clock/application semantics to the configured Ribasim version. MF6 timestep cadence alone is therefore not sufficient evidence of UserDemand application cadence.
boundaries: This is pinned-source product-driver authority, not a full dynamic kernel run.
No SWAP5 driver or upstream source was modified.
No claim that the later DUMMY-19 Ribasim source semantics equal the older Ribasim release downloaded by this iMOD Coupler pin.
downstream: Qualify DUMMY-20B against the exact Ribasim v2026.1.1 source consumed by this product pin before runtime product testing.
